body:
Hi Masafumi-san,

I totally overlooked this, agreed, the measurement range is completely off.

We need to do something different.

What accuracy can we expect if we follow the RC car demo concept?

Br

Stefan

 

From: 金子 雅史 Masafumi Kaneko <masafumi.kaneko@alpsalpine.com>
Sent: 24 July 2026 03:54
To: Stefan Huber <Stefan.Huber@alpsalpine.com>; Josef Nevrly <jnevrly@alps.cz>; Lars Junger <Lars.Junger@alpsalpine.com>
Cc: Luca Marchetti <luca.marchetti@alpsalpine.com>; Christoph Geue <christoph.geue@alpsalpine.com>; 西村 幸治 Koji Nishimura <koji.nishimura@alpsalpine.com>; 竹谷 努 Tsutomu Takeya <tsutomu.takeya@alpsalpine.com>
Subject: RE: Question on the GMR sensor demo

 

Hi Stefan-san,

 

Regarding current measurement by Non-contact / Coreless,

DC 1-5A current range will be quite difficult even the other Magnetic sensor.

Usually, this quite small range is  working Shunt resistance.

 

We have several idea of just use case for demo.

1).

For Radio control car demo,

The demo is wiring over 70 times as coil around Sensor board for Magnetic field increasing.

And, on your case, 1pc is just to show, the other 1 pc is for measurement in backside.

2).

 

For AC current, we have dryer demo. This demo is direct measurement of supply cable.

Let’s think about this dryer case.

・Dryer Spec.

- Power : 1,500W

- Supply voltage : AC 100V

- Calculated Current : 15App = ±7A@around 50% duty

・Sensor IC Spec. (Custom calibration)

- Sensor Sensitivity : 0.067 V/V/mT

±6mT@Center 2.5V±2Vrange

・Magnetic Circuit Design

　- Coeff cation from Voltage to Ampere : 210 A/V

　- Supply source in Japan : 100V

　　→ Target displayed output : Adjusted to ±15App

　　　

　　→ Magnetic field = 15A / 210A/V / 5V / 0.067V/V/mT

= 0.213mT　---- 3.55% of Dynamic range (6mT Half scale)

Key point in Demo design is figuring out how strong Magnetic field it can be generated.

 

If you have good idea, please share us.

 

Regards,

Masafumi Kaneko

Hi Stefan,

 

Thanks for a quick reply.

 

The conveyor belt drive will be 24V DC, and the current will be in 1~5 A range. I think it will be difficult to include the robot arm into the measurement (different power source), but I’ll check.

 

BR,

 

Josef

Subject: RE: Question on the GMR sensor demo

 

Hi Josef,

Just synchronised with Lars, agreed, let ALCZ focus on Chocolate quality and handling  and AAEU will get to deal with current 😉

Only remaining question is which current range to sense so that ALAP can calibrate ahead?

 

Hi Masafumi-san,

ALEU team would have the below material available to read out the current values:

Adafruit FeatherWing OLED - 128x64 OLED Add-on For Feather 4650

Display

Adafruit QT Py S3 WiFi Dev Board with 2MB PSRAM STEMMA QT 5700

https://eckstein-shop.de/Adafruit-QT-Py-S3-WiFi-Dev-Board-with-2MB-PSRAM-STEMMA-QT

 

Is this compatible in terms of sensor output signal?

We would also have the option to use this one for signal enhancement:

Adafruit ADS1115 16-Bit ADC 4 Channel with Programmable Gain Amplifier 1085

Amplifier

 

Best regards,

Stefan

Subject: RE: Question on the GMR sensor demo

 

Hi Stefan,

 

For our setup, any current sensor device that can work in 1~5A DC range would work, bus-bar style or edelweiss style – doesn’t matter (but I think it should look in a way which conveys the idea of the GMR-based current measurement well).

 

However for the data/readout (I assume over Modbus ?) -> display, it would be helpful if this could be implemented on AAEU side. I think CZ team will have enough troubles with the choclate factory 😉.

 

Best regards,

 

Josef

From: Stefan Huber <Stefan.Huber@alpsalpine.com>
Sent: Monday, July 20, 2026 9:49 PM
To: 金子 雅史 Masafumi Kaneko <masafumi.kaneko@alpsalpine.com>
Cc: Luca Marchetti <luca.marchetti@alpsalpine.com>; Christoph Geue <christoph.geue@alpsalpine.com>; 西村 幸治 Koji Nishimura <koji.nishimura@alpsalpine.com>; 竹谷 努 Tsutomu Takeya <tsutomu.takeya@alpsalpine.com>; Josef Nevrly <jnevrly@alps.cz>
Subject: RE: Question on the GMR sensor demo

 

Dear Masafumi,

Let me come back to the Electronica demo. See below a picture of the latest planning.

We see two options now:

  1. We show a dummy sensor and fake data

→ I don’t have any idea.

  1. We integrate s sensor into the demo and show true value (24V / ~1-5A DC)

→ We can issue special calibrated sample (1-2 pcs).

It will be calibrated to ±6mT dynamic range. (Sensitivity : 0.067 V/V/mT).

Of cause, this sample do not have datasheet.

Magnetic field strength will be depending on your busbar design.

  1. We integrate the existing demo and feed the value into a small display)

→ SED have 2 type of demo.

For AC current, Dryer demo.

　               For DC current, Radio control car (BMW i8).

　               Both demo are using same sample as 2). (Sensitivity : 0.067 V/V/mT)

                   And, I attached setup manual ppt file for both.

What do you think? If 2 or 3, Josef would kindly request the data sheets of the corresponding sensor we select so he can check how to integrate.

Best regards,

Stefan
